title.to: The welcome message became the boss

description.from: Ryan-requested draft following discussion of OpenAI’s 25 September 2026 self-replicating prompt injection report. Reporting angle: malicious text travels in legitimate replies; memory could preserve the instruction as standing procedure. Keep demonstrated transmission, independently tested memory persistence, and the hypothetical combined email worm distinct. One documented laboratory scene; no invented victim or claimed live outbreak. Board draft only.
description.to: Board draft requested by Ryan on 29 September 2026. One documented research scene: the AgentWorm paper’s representative Alice–Bob–Carol exchange, in which a welcome induces a standing-rule change and the recipient passes it to the next test agent. Reporting and editorial artifacts are in stories/PILO-de5a6b3a-37e0-4c0d-ade4-ea6b3d699d1e/. Original OpenAI email finding provides a short contextual echo; the every-future-email version remains explicitly conditional. Controlled experiment, no claimed live outbreak. Draft pending Ryan’s review.
